mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (company_id, receiver_account_id, notification_type, title, message, approval_document_id, it_ticket_id, dedupe_key) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{receiverAccountId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{approvalDocumentId}, #{itTicketId}, #{dedupeKey})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, notification_type, title, message, approval_document_id, it_ticket_id, TO_CHAR(read_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS read_at, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at FROM notification WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND receiver_account_id = #{userAccountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
